title: Initiation Trial Assessment Precision & PDF Extraction (v0.4.23)
message: Initiation Trial now directly extracts embedded multiple-choice questions, choices, and answer keys verbatim from custom reading materials (such as Pre-Test and Post-Test documents), preserves question order, dynamically expands item counts, and invalidates stale quiz caches.
changelog:
• PDF Embedded Quiz Extraction: Initiation Trial now extracts exact questions, options, and answer keys verbatim from custom reading PDFs rather than inventing generic AI questions.
• Deterministic Local Parser: Integrated offline-safe regex extraction for structured questionnaires if AI or network is temporarily unavailable.
• Sequential Order & Item Count Expansion: Preserved original question numbering and allowed target quiz items to scale with the document's question count.
• Quiz Schema Invalidation: Introduced schema_version = 2 to bypass and refresh stale, previously hallucinated quizzes.
• Multi-Material Sequence Support: Loaded all configured teacher custom slots (1 through 4) in sequential order with dynamic title tracking.
